title: Pathology, Dermatology & Ophthalmology
blurb: Whole-slide histopathology, dermoscopic and clinical skin images, retinal fundus and OCT collections.

items.name: CAMELYON16/17
items.description: Whole-slide images of sentinel lymph nodes from breast-cancer patients with pixel-level metastasis annotations (1,399 WSIs) from Dutch medical centres.
items.access_note: Open download (CC0) via AWS Open Data / GigaScience.

paper.label: Ehteshami Bejnordi B et al. JAMA 2017;318:2199

items.name: PANDA
items.description: ~11,000 prostate biopsy whole-slide images from Radboud and Karolinska with ISUP grade and Gleason labels.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

paper.label: Bulten W et al. Nat Med 2022;28:154

items.name: PatchCamelyon (PCam)
items.description: 327,680 96×96 histopathology patches derived from CAMELYON16 with binary metastasis labels — an MNIST-sized pathology benchmark.

paper.label: Veeling BS et al. MICCAI 2018

items.name: BreakHis
items.description: 7,909 microscopic images of breast tumour tissue from 82 patients at four magnifications, labelled benign or malignant with subtypes.

paper.label: Spanhol FA et al. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2016;63:1455

items.name: ISIC Archive
items.description: The largest public collection of dermoscopic images of skin lesions (>400,000), with diagnoses and metadata, home of the annual ISIC melanoma challenges.
items.access_note: Open download and API (mostly CC BY / CC BY-NC).

items.name: HAM10000
items.description: 10,015 dermoscopic images of common pigmented skin lesions across 7 diagnostic categories, >50% histopathology-confirmed.
items.access_note: Direct download from Harvard Dataverse (CC BY-NC).

paper.label: Tschandl P et al. Sci Data 2018;5:180161

items.name: Fitzpatrick 17k
items.description: 16,577 clinical skin-condition images across 114 conditions annotated with Fitzpatrick skin type to study fairness in dermatology AI.
items.access_note: Image URLs and labels on GitHub.

paper.label: Groh M et al. CVPR Workshops 2021

items.name: DDI
items.description: 656 biopsy-proven clinical images emphasising Fitzpatrick skin types V–VI and uncommon diseases, built to expose bias in dermatology algorithms.
items.access_note: Free registration and research-use agreement (Stanford AIMI).

paper.label: Daneshjou R et al. Sci Adv 2022;8:eabq6147

items.name: PAD-UFES-20
items.description: 2,298 smartphone images of skin lesions from 1,373 Brazilian patients with clinical metadata across six diagnoses.
items.access_note: Direct download from Mendeley Data (CC BY 4.0).

paper.label: Pacheco AGC et al. Data Brief 2020;32:106221

items.name: EyePACS Diabetic Retinopathy (Kaggle)
items.description: ~88,000 retinal fundus photographs graded 0–4 for diabetic retinopathy, released for the 2015 Kaggle competition.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

items.name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection
items.description: ~5,600 fundus images from rural Indian screening programmes (Aravind Eye Hospital) graded for diabetic retinopathy severity.
items.access_note: Free Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules.

items.name: IDRiD
items.description: 516 high-resolution fundus images with pixel-level lesion annotations, DR/DME grades and optic disc/fovea locations.

paper.label: Porwal P et al. Data 2018;3:25

items.name: Messidor-2
items.description: 1,748 macula-centred fundus images from 874 diabetic examinations, widely used to validate DR screening algorithms.

paper.label: Decencière E et al. Image Anal Stereol 2014;33:231

items.name: DRIVE
items.full_name: Digital Retinal Images for Vessel Extraction
items.description: 40 colour fundus images with manual retinal-vessel segmentations — the classic vessel-segmentation benchmark.

paper.label: Staal J et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2004;23:501

items.name: REFUGE
items.description: 1,200 fundus images with glaucoma labels and optic disc/cup segmentations from Chinese hospitals.

paper.label: Orlando JI et al. Med Image Anal 2020;59:101570

items.name: NCT-CRC-HE-100K
items.description: 100,000 H&E image patches of human colorectal cancer and normal tissue in nine tissue classes.

paper.label: Kather JN et al. PLoS Med 2019;16:e1002730

items.name: STARC-9
items.description: 630,000 colorectal tissue image tiles across nine tissue classes for training pathology classifiers.

items.name: PanNuke
items.description: Nuclei instance segmentation and classification (~200,000 nuclei) across 19 tissue types.

paper.label: Gamper J et al. arXiv 2020

items.name: NuCLS
items.description: 220,000+ crowdsourced and expert-reviewed nucleus labels from TCGA breast cancer slides.

paper.label: Amgad M et al. GigaScience 2022;11:giac037

items.name: DiagSet
items.description: Prostate cancer histopathology: 2.6 million patches and 4,675 whole-slide scans with diagnoses.

paper.label: Koziarski M et al. Sci Rep 2024;14:6780

items.name: PLISM
items.description: Pathology images of the same tissues captured with different whole-slide scanners and smartphones, for studying domain shift.

items.name: 3D Pathology Triage Datasets
items.description: 3D pathology image volumes of prostate and oesophageal tissue with binary labels for deep-learning triage of 3D microscopy.

items.name: NLM Malaria Cell Images
items.description: 27,558 segmented thin blood-smear red-cell images, evenly split between Plasmodium-parasitised and uninfected.

paper.label: Rajaraman S et al. PeerJ 2018;6:e4568

items.name: PH²
items.description: 200 dermoscopic images of melanocytic lesions with expert segmentations and diagnoses from Hospital Pedro Hispano, Portugal.
items.access_note: Free; fill a short registration form to download.

paper.label: Mendonça T et al. IEEE EMBC 2013

items.name: MED-NODE
items.description: 170 non-dermoscopic clinical images of melanoma and naevi from the University Medical Center Groningen.

paper.label: Giotis I et al. Expert Syst Appl 2015;42:6578

items.name: Derm7pt (Seven-Point Checklist)
items.description: 1,011 cases with clinical and dermoscopic images annotated with the seven-point melanoma checklist and diagnoses.

paper.label: Kawahara J et al. IEEE J Biomed Health Inform 2019;23:538

items.name: Dermatology DDx (Uncertain Ground Truth)
items.description: 1,947 teledermatology cases with differential diagnoses from multiple dermatologists across 419 conditions, for studying label uncertainty.

items.name: SNU Dermatology Dataset
items.description: 2,201 clinical skin images across 174 diseases with quizzes, released with the Seoul National University dermatology AI studies.

items.name: ENCoDE Skin Colour Dataset
items.description: Objective skin-tone measurements linked to EHR data (167 variables) to study pulse-oximetry and other device bias.

items.name: BRSET
items.description: 16,266 retinal fundus photographs from 8,524 Brazilian patients with demographics and multi-label diagnoses.
items.provider: Federal University of São Paulo / MIT

paper.label: Nakayama LF et al. PLOS Digit Health 2024;3:e0000454

items.name: mBRSET
items.description: 5,164 smartphone retinal images from 1,291 diabetic patients in Brazil with DR grades and systemic data.
items.provider: Federal University of São Paulo / MIT

items.name: Hillel Yaffe Glaucoma Dataset (HYGD)
items.description: 747 fundus images with gold-standard glaucoma labels based on full ophthalmic examination.

items.name: FFA-IR
items.description: 47,247 fundus fluorescein angiography images from 10,790 reports with lesion annotations, for explainable report generation.

items.name: HRF
items.description: 45 high-resolution fundus images (healthy, diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma) with vessel segmentations.

paper.label: Budai A et al. Int J Biomed Imaging 2013:154860

items.name: RIGA
items.description: 750 fundus images with optic disc and cup boundaries marked by six ophthalmologists (4,500 annotations) for glaucoma research.
items.access_note: Direct download from Deep Blue Data.

paper.label: Almazroa A et al. Proc SPIE 2018;10579

items.name: DR HAGIS
items.description: 39 fundus images from a UK diabetic screening programme with manual vessel segmentations, covering comorbidities.

paper.label: Holm S et al. J Med Imaging 2017;4:014503

items.name: SUSTech-SYSU Corneal Ulcer Dataset
items.description: 712 fluorescein-stained ocular surface images with corneal ulcer segmentations and type/grade labels.
items.provider: Southern University of Science and Technology / Sun Yat-sen University

paper.label: Deng L et al. Sci Data 2020;7:23

items.name: RIM-ONE DL
items.description: Fundus images with optic disc and cup segmentations, curated for deep-learning glaucoma assessment.
